architecture_correction: Runtime liveness, recovery, local verification and continuation are resident-runtime responsibilities. GitHub is source/history and optional external audit, not a runtime host dependency.

host_lineage.claim_boundary: The artifact is used as architectural host lineage; this binding record does not claim the notebook itself is currently executing.

resident_control_loop: run local hostile oracles on cadence
recover supervisor after exit or repeated health failure
preserve continuation state independently of GitHub Actions
forbidden_substitutions: HTTP response from stale process == current deployment generation verified
promotion_rule: Resident runtime claims require local process identity, health/readback, lifecycle proof and current-generation evidence. GitHub status is not a prerequisite.
